# Hackr.io

> > Hackr.io is a community-driven platform for discovering and sharing the best programming tutorials and courses across languages and technologies.

Hackr.io aggregates user-recommended tutorials for learning programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Rust, Java, C++, PHP), web development frameworks (React, Laravel, Symfony), tools (Docker, Git, VSCode), platforms (Linux, Arduino, Unity, Unreal), and specialized topics like machine learning, data science, and security. The platform helps developers find high-quality learning resources vetted by the community.

## Key Topics

- Python
- JavaScript
- Rust
- Machine Learning
- Data Science
- Web Development
- PHP Frameworks
- Linux
- Docker
- React
- Git Version Control
- Information Security
- C++
- Java
- Tutorial Catalogs

## Popular Programming Languages

- [Machine Learning (Stanford University) — Learn Machine Learning](https://hackr.io/tutorial/machine-learning-stanford-university): Stanford University Machine Learning course tutorials catalog
- [Learn Python for Data Science — Learn Python](https://hackr.io/tutorial/learn-python-for-data-science): Python tutorials focused on data science and analysis
- [Think Python (2nd edition) — Learn Python](https://hackr.io/tutorial/think-python): Think Python 2nd edition book tutorial for beginners
- [Python Programming Tutorials — Learn Python](https://hackr.io/tutorial/python-programming-tutorials): Comprehensive Python programming tutorials catalog
- [Rust Programming Language — Learn Rust](https://hackr.io/tutorial/the-rust-programming-language): Official Rust programming language tutorial and learning resources
- [Rust: The Basics — Learn Rust](https://hackr.io/tutorial/rust-the-basics): Beginner-focused Rust programming basics tutorial
- [Learn Julia The Hard Way — Learn Julia](https://hackr.io/tutorial/learn-julia-the-hard-way): Julia programming tutorial using the 'hard way' learning method
- [Learn Prolog [2026] Most Recommended Tutorials](https://hackr.io/tutorials/learn-prolog): Curated directory of recommended Prolog programming tutorials
